about: The text a thing is shown by in a drawing (editor spec §3, shown_text_ranked; Roger, 22 Oct 2026). The first that gives text wins: the property its schema names (shown_by), a name key (name, title, text, label), a wording key (statement, summary, heading, question, description), the first readable text in the order written, then its id. Text longer than 80 characters is cut at a word and ends in …. Both libraries run these cases: packages/graph-spec/test/shown-text.test.mjs and python/graph_spec/tests/test_shown_text.py. Each case gives its block, its graph and, for each thing, [text, key]; the key is null for an id.
